title: Salad in the meadow
slide_intent: Show food with enough ingredient detail to make freshness tangible rather than merely asserted.
strategic_value: The colorful bowl among living plants can reinforce Sweetgreen’s relationship to growing food.
demonstration: An abundant salad bowl rests in grass and small yellow flowers, photographed close enough to distinguish its ingredients.
practical_value: Decide how much environmental context can surround a product without obscuring what is being offered.

content_islands.name: Bowl
content_islands.spec: Make the filled bowl the central, sharply described subject.

content_islands.name: Growing environment
content_islands.spec: Retain the grass, stems and flowers around it as a continuous setting.

reference_purposes.Expression: Close food detail is paired with an outdoor growing environment.
